rows.en: Even you, [HERO4]…
It's all right, Saburo! I'll go along with them…
Huh…!?
Looks like… they've made me a member of this team too, huh?
It's okay, Saburo! I'll go along with them…
Come on, let's climb aboard!
Hey, One-Seven! Is this okay? Letting One-Eight do whatever he wants?
SABURO, YOU HOP ON TOO, HOP ON!
One-Eight, you…
DON'T WORRY, DON'T WORRY…
ONE-EIGHT, DON'T GO!
NO WAY!!
I WILL BRING ONE-EIGHT BACK!
One-Seven…
Ah, it's One-Seven! One-Eight, don't lose to One-Seven!
ONE-EIGHT, WHERE ARE YOU GOING?
Yahoo, we beat One-Seven! One-Eight, go even faster!
ONE-EIGHT, NUMBER ONE IN SPEED!
Yazaki… let's head back soon, shall we? I think everyone will be worried.

No way!

One-Eight, can you beat Brain?

…!?

Yazaki!!
Yazaki… let's head back soon! I bet everyone's worried.
BRAIN?
That's right, Brain!
I CAN WIN!!
Then go get 'em! Take out Brain!
Yazaki…!? That's a job for the TDF and [HERO4] and the others!
That's right… This is getting too dangerous! Let's stop One-Eight.
That's right… This is getting too dangerous! Stop One-Eight, Yazaki!
ONE-EIGHT WILL BEAT BRAIN!
All right, attack!
Yazaki… is this going to be okay…?
Mister Brain! One-Eight is here!
Hah hah hah… So it's finally Haken Killer's turn, is it?

…!?

A Brain robot!!
Go! One-Eight!!
What's going to happen to us…?

It's all right!

I'm here with you! If worst comes to worst…

It's okay!

I'm here with you, after all!
Aaah!? H-Help meee!!
One-Seven and One-Eight… together they're invincible, but one alone can be beaten! One-Eight has walked right into Brain's trap. And so have Rumi and the others…
The assassin robot that has appeared… Haken Killer is strong!! Now, hurry! One-Seven!!
B-BROTHER…
One-Seven, Graviton attack!
YES! GRAVITOOON!!

…!?

It dodged the Graviton attack!? One-Seven's in danger!

Once One-Seven uses the Graviton attack, he can't use it again in a row! This is bad…
ONE-EIGHT…
B-BROTHER…!

One-Seven…

let's take One-Eight and retreat for now! At this rate, we'll be beaten!
YES!

So this is One-Seven's cave?

Saburo… do you think One-Eight will be able to get back up?
HE WILL BE ALL RIGHT… HIS REACTOR IS SOLID!
FORGIVE ME, BROTHER… IF WE HAD ATTACKED TOGETHER, WE WOULD HAVE WON…
He walked right into Brain's trap… hook, line and sinker.
ONE-EIGHT IS ASHAMED…
I was reckless too! All because I didn't want to lose to you, Saburo… I'm sorry!
It's fine… We're friends, right?
Saburo…
But… maybe Team One-Eight should break up… It'll only lead to fights!
But… Team One-Eight is breaking up! It's just a source of fights…
Okaaay!
Yes, this is Officer Minami!
What? Brain robots are attacking the TDF lab…
Saburo! Send out One-Seven right away.

Understood!

One-Seven, the lab is in danger! Sortie right away!
NO.
No? Why not!?
NOT YET… I CANNOT USE GRAVITON.
CANNOT USE IT…?
Mister Brain! One-Seven isn't coming out! What now?
Keep attacking until One-Seven appears! Send Haken Killer out as well.
Concentrate fire on the Brain robots! Everyone, spread out and draw the enemy away! Lure them as far from the lab as you can!
Commence attack!!
So fast…!? What is this robot…?
One-Seven! Can't you use Graviton yet?
GRAVITON… IT WILL BE HARD TO USE ON THIS BRAIN ROBOT…
HARD TO USE GRAVITON…?
One-Eight…? What's wrong?
ONE-EIGHT? WHAT ARE YOU DOING!?
SABURO! IT IS DANGEROUS INSIDE THE CAVE! RUN!!

uncertain: U14267: One-Eight referred to as 'he' (robot, younger brother of One-Seven).
U14268-U14340: One-Seven/One-Eight katakana speech rendered in capitals; One-Seven speaks stiffly.
U14312: ゲンシロ read as 原子炉 ('reactor').
U14323: narration row continues Saburo's radio call; the verb (attacking) is supplied from context.
U14301/U14302: narrator's dramatic aside ('Now, hurry! One-Seven!!') kept.
